name: realbud
description: RealBud — a private business workspace with real-estate workflows, shared office records and a managed Hermes assistant.

scripts.qa:full: pnpm qa && pnpm qa:company && pnpm qa:second-office && pnpm qa:seat-isolation && pnpm qa:scale && pnpm qa:live-worker
scripts.qa: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm qa:e2e
scripts.check:electron: node --check electron/main.mjs && node --check electron/terminal-launch.mjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/capabilities.cjs && node --check electron/perm-settings.cjs && node --check electron/cua-connection.cjs && node --check electron/cua.mjs && node --check electron/speech.mjs && node --check electron/shutdown.mjs && node --check electron/server-supervisor.mjs && node --check electron/service-instance.mjs && node --check electron/service-lifecycle.mjs && node --check electron/build-speech-helper-win.mjs
scripts.package:prepare: pnpm build && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:updater && pnpm build:browser
scripts.package:mac: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:speech && pnpm build:cua && pnpm build:postgres && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:release: pnpm package:mac && pnpm package:mac:notarize && pnpm clean:release
scripts.package:win: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:speech:win && pnpm build:cua && pnpm build:postgres && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:linux: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:postgres && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:dir: pnpm package:prepare && pnpm build:postgres && electron-builder --linux dir --x64 --publish never
